entries.title: History of New York Stock Exchange Holidays (revised through November 2008)
entries.notes: The standard-holiday table (years observed, Rule 51 on Saturday holidays) and the "Special Closings, 1885–date" list. Primary source for everything before 2008.

entries.title: Structured rule model derived from `nyse-history-2008`
entries.notes: Machine-readable transcription of the PDF (holiday rules, Saturday closings, observed-Friday lists, weekend history). Used to generate `us_nyse_special_closings_pre1960`.

entries.title: NYSE Holidays & Trading Hours
entries.notes: Published holiday and early-close schedule. Also the source for post-2008 one-off closings: Hurricane Sandy (2012-10-29/30), national days of mourning for George H. W. Bush (2018-12-05) and Jimmy Carter (2025-01-09).
